# managers/progression_manager.gd
extends Node
class_name ProgressionManager

## Менеджер прогрессии - управляет сложностью и статистикой

signal run_started(run_number: int, difficulty: float)
signal run_ended(run_number: int, reward: float, success: bool)
signal difficulty_changed(new_difficulty: float)

# Параметры сложности
@export var base_difficulty: float = 1.0
@export var difficulty_increase_per_run: float = 0.2
@export var pulses_to_win_base: int = 3
@export var difficulty_increase_per_pulse: float = 0.15

# Параметры масштабирования
@export var health_scale_per_run: float = 0.15
@export var speed_scale_per_run: float = 0.05
@export var damage_scale_per_run: float = 0.15

# Текущее состояние
var current_run: int = 1
var current_difficulty: float = 1.0
var pulses_to_win: int = 5

# Статистика
var total_runs: int = 0
var total_wins: int = 0
var stalkers_killed: int = 0
var anomalies_created: int = 0
var mutants_spawned: int = 0
var artifacts_stolen: int = 0
var total_biomass_earned: float = 0.0

# Внутреннее
var _current_biomass: float = 0.0


func _ready():
    add_to_group("progression_manager")
    pass # print("ProgressionManager инициализирован", "ProgressionManager")


# ==================== ЗАБЕГИ ====================

func start_new_run() -> Dictionary:
    current_run = total_runs + 1
    current_difficulty = base_difficulty + (current_run - 1) * difficulty_increase_per_run
    # Фиксированная цель, совпадает с pulses_to_win в EventManager
    pulses_to_win = pulses_to_win_base
    _current_biomass = 0.0
    
    pass # print("Забег #" + str(current_run) + " | Сложность: " + str(current_difficulty) + " | Цель: " + str(pulses_to_win) + " выбросов", "ProgressionManager")
    
    run_started.emit(current_run, current_difficulty)
    
    return {
        "run_number": current_run,
        "difficulty": current_difficulty,
        "pulses_to_win": pulses_to_win
    }


func end_run(success: bool, accumulated_biomass: float) -> float:
    total_runs += 1
    _current_biomass = accumulated_biomass
    
    var reward = 0.0
    if success:
        total_wins += 1
        reward = _calculate_reward(accumulated_biomass)
        total_biomass_earned += reward
    
    pass # print("Забег #" + str(current_run) + " завершён. Успех: " + str(success) + " | Награда: " + str(reward), "ProgressionManager")
    run_ended.emit(current_run, reward, success)
    
    return reward


func _calculate_reward(accumulated: float) -> float:
    var base_reward = 100.0 * current_run
    var difficulty_mult = current_difficulty
    var accumulated_part = accumulated * 0.3
    return accumulated_part + (base_reward * difficulty_mult)


func increase_difficulty(amount: float = difficulty_increase_per_pulse):
    current_difficulty += amount
    difficulty_changed.emit(current_difficulty)
    pass # print("Сложность увеличена до: " + str(current_difficulty), "ProgressionManager")


# ==================== МНОЖИТЕЛИ ====================

func get_health_multiplier() -> float:
    return 1.0 + (current_run - 1) * health_scale_per_run


func get_speed_multiplier() -> float:
    return 1.0 + (current_run - 1) * speed_scale_per_run


func get_damage_multiplier() -> float:
    return 1.0 + (current_run - 1) * damage_scale_per_run


# ==================== СТАТИСТИКА ====================

func record_stalker_killed():
    stalkers_killed += 1


func record_anomaly_created():
    anomalies_created += 1


func record_mutant_spawned():
    mutants_spawned += 1


func record_artifact_stolen():
    artifacts_stolen += 1


func get_stalkers_killed() -> int:
    return stalkers_killed


func get_anomalies_created() -> int:
    return anomalies_created


func get_mutants_spawned() -> int:
    return mutants_spawned


func get_artifacts_stolen() -> int:
    return artifacts_stolen


func get_statistics() -> Dictionary:
    return {
        "total_runs": total_runs,
        "total_wins": total_wins,
        "win_rate": float(total_wins) / max(1, total_runs) * 100.0,
        "stalkers_killed": stalkers_killed,
        "anomalies_created": anomalies_created,
        "mutants_spawned": mutants_spawned,
        "artifacts_stolen": artifacts_stolen,
        "total_biomass_earned": total_biomass_earned,
        "current_run": current_run,
        "current_difficulty": current_difficulty
    }


func reset_statistics():
    total_runs = 0
    total_wins = 0
    stalkers_killed = 0
    anomalies_created = 0
    mutants_spawned = 0
    artifacts_stolen = 0
    total_biomass_earned = 0.0
    _current_biomass = 0.0
    pass # print("Статистика сброшена", "ProgressionManager")


# ==================== ГЕТТЕРЫ ====================

func get_current_run() -> int:
    return current_run


func get_current_difficulty() -> float:
    return current_difficulty


func get_pulses_to_win() -> int:
    return pulses_to_win


func is_first_run() -> bool:
    return current_run == 1

# managers/resource_manager.gd
extends Node
class_name ResourceManager

## Менеджер ресурсов - управляет энергией и биомассой

signal energy_changed(current: float, max_value: float)
signal biomass_changed(current: float, max_value: float)
signal critical_biomass_reached(percent: float)

# Параметры
@export var max_energy: float = 1000.0:
    set(value):
        max_energy = value
        current_energy = min(current_energy, max_energy)
        energy_changed.emit(current_energy, max_energy)

@export var max_biomass: float = 5000.0:
    set(value):
        max_biomass = value
        current_biomass = min(current_biomass, max_biomass)
        biomass_changed.emit(current_biomass, max_biomass)

@export var energy_regen_rate: float = 5.0
@export var critical_threshold: float = 0.4

# Текущие значения
var current_energy: float:
    set(value):
        var old_value = current_energy
        current_energy = clamp(value, 0.0, max_energy)
        if current_energy != old_value:
            energy_changed.emit(current_energy, max_energy)
            _check_critical_energy()

var current_biomass: float:
    set(value):
        var old_value = current_biomass
        current_biomass = clamp(value, 0.0, max_biomass)
        if current_biomass != old_value:
            biomass_changed.emit(current_biomass, max_biomass)
            _check_critical_biomass()

# Аккумулированная биомасса за забег
var accumulated_biomass: float = 0.0


func _ready():
    add_to_group("resource_manager")
    current_energy = max_energy * 0.5
    current_biomass = max_biomass * 0.3
    set_process(true)
    pass # print("ResourceManager инициализирован", "ResourceManager")


func _process(delta):
    # Регенерация энергии
    if current_energy < max_energy:
        current_energy += energy_regen_rate * delta


# ==================== ЭНЕРГИЯ ====================

func add_energy(amount: float):
    current_energy += amount
    # (лог отключён)


func spend_energy(amount: float) -> bool:
    if current_energy >= amount:
        current_energy -= amount
        # (лог отключён)
        return true
    pass # print("Недостаточно энергии: нужно " + str(amount) + ", есть " + str(current_energy), "ResourceManager")
    return false


func get_energy() -> float:
    return current_energy


func get_energy_percent() -> float:
    return current_energy / max_energy if max_energy > 0 else 0.0


func _check_critical_energy():
    # Предупреждение убрано по запросу: критическая энергия не требует реакции
    pass


# ==================== БИОМАССА ====================

func add_biomass(amount: float):
    current_biomass += amount
    accumulated_biomass += amount
    # (лог отключён)


func spend_biomass(amount: float) -> bool:
    if current_biomass >= amount:
        current_biomass -= amount
        # (лог отключён)
        return true
    pass # print("Недостаточно биомассы: нужно " + str(amount) + ", есть " + str(current_biomass), "ResourceManager")
    return false


func get_biomass() -> float:
    return current_biomass


func get_biomass_percent() -> float:
    return current_biomass / max_biomass if max_biomass > 0 else 0.0


var _critical_biomass_latched: bool = false


func _check_critical_biomass():
    # Одноразовый срабатыватель: пока биомасса не упадёт заметно ниже порога,
    # повторные добавления не запускают новые выбросы
    if current_biomass >= max_biomass * critical_threshold:
        if _critical_biomass_latched:
            return
        _critical_biomass_latched = true
        critical_biomass_reached.emit(get_biomass_percent())
        # (лог отключён)
    elif _critical_biomass_latched and current_biomass < max_biomass * critical_threshold:
        _critical_biomass_latched = false


# ==================== УТИЛИТЫ ====================

func can_afford(energy_cost: float, biomass_cost: float) -> bool:
    return current_energy >= energy_cost and current_biomass >= biomass_cost


func reset():
    current_energy = max_energy * 0.5
    current_biomass = max_biomass * 0.3
    accumulated_biomass = 0.0
    pass # print("Ресурсы сброшены", "ResourceManager")


func get_status() -> Dictionary:
    return {
        "energy": current_energy,
        "max_energy": max_energy,
        "energy_percent": get_energy_percent(),
        "biomass": current_biomass,
        "max_biomass": max_biomass,
        "biomass_percent": get_biomass_percent(),
        "accumulated": accumulated_biomass
    }

# managers/sound_manager.gd
extends Node
class_name SoundManager

## Менеджер звуков - управляет аудио

signal music_changed(track_name: String)
signal sound_played(sound_name: String)

@export var master_volume: float = 1.0
@export var music_volume: float = 0.7
@export var sfx_volume: float = 0.8

# Музыкальные треки (загружаются извне)
var music_tracks: Dictionary = {}
var ambient_sounds: Dictionary = {}
var anomaly_sounds: Dictionary = {}
var mutant_sounds: Dictionary = {}
var footstep_sounds: Dictionary = {}

# Плееры
var _music_player: AudioStreamPlayer
var _ambient_player: AudioStreamPlayer
var _sfx_players: Array[AudioStreamPlayer] = []

# Состояние
var _current_music_track: String = ""
var _target_music: AudioStream = null
var _music_fade_timer: float = 0.0
var _music_fade_duration: float = 1.0
var _is_music_playing: bool = false


func _ready():
    _setup_players()
    _register_dummy_sounds()  # Сначала заглушки - как фолбэк на отсутствующие файлы
    _register_real_sounds()   # Затем реальный пак (перезаписывает, где файлы есть)
    add_to_group("sound_manager")
    pass # print("SoundManager инициализирован", "SoundManager")


# Варианты шагов по поверхностям: поверхность -> массив клипов
var footstep_variants: Dictionary = {}


func _register_real_sounds():
    ## Пак из assets/audio (CC0, подготовлен агентом-подготовщиком).
    ## Имя файла = ключ: sfx/<ключ>.ogg, music/<трек>.ogg
    var keys := {
        "footstep_sounds": ["ui_hover", "ui_click", "upgrade", "exchange", "pulse_warning"],
        "anomaly_sounds": ["electric", "thermal", "gravity", "chemical", "radiation"],
        "mutant_sounds": ["bloodsucker", "flesh", "snork", "pseudodog", "controller",
            "poltergeist", "chimera", "zombie"],
    }
    for dict_name in keys:
        var dict: Dictionary = get(dict_name)
        for key in keys[dict_name]:
            var path := "res://assets/audio/sfx/%s.ogg" % key
            if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
                dict[key] = load(path)

    # Шаги: surface -> step_<surface>_NN.ogg, до 6 вариантов на поверхность
    for surface in ["grass", "sand", "stone", "water"]:
        var variants: Array = []
        for i in range(1, 7):
            var path := "res://assets/audio/sfx/step_%s_%02d.ogg" % [surface, i]
            if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
                variants.append(load(path))
        if not variants.is_empty():
            footstep_sounds[surface] = variants[0]
            footstep_variants[surface] = variants

    # Музыка: menu / lab / run
    for track in ["menu", "lab", "run"]:
        var path := "res://assets/audio/music/music_%s.ogg" % track
        if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
            music_tracks[track] = load(path)


func _setup_players():
    # Музыка
    _music_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
    _music_player.name = "MusicPlayer"
    _music_player.bus = "Music"
    _music_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(music_volume)
    add_child(_music_player)
    
    # Окружение
    _ambient_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
    _ambient_player.name = "AmbientPlayer"
    _ambient_player.bus = "Ambient"
    _ambient_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(sfx_volume * 0.5)
    add_child(_ambient_player)
    
    # Пулы SFX игроков
    for i in range(5):
        var player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
        player.name = "SFXPlayer_" + str(i)
        player.bus = "SFX"
        player.volume_db = linear_to_db(sfx_volume)
        add_child(player)
        _sfx_players.append(player)
    
    pass # print("Аудиоплееры созданы: 1 музыка, 1 окружение, 5 SFX", "SoundManager")


func _register_dummy_sounds():
    # Создаем заглушки для UI звуков
    var dummy_stream = AudioStreamWAV.new()
    dummy_stream.data = []  # Пустой WAV файл
    dummy_stream.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
    dummy_stream.mix_rate = 44100
    dummy_stream.stereo = false
    
    # Регистрируем все необходимые звуки
    footstep_sounds["ui_hover"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["ui_click"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["upgrade"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["exchange"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["pulse_warning"] = dummy_stream
    
    # Базовые звуки для аномалий
    anomaly_sounds["electric"] = dummy_stream
    anomaly_sounds["thermal"] = dummy_stream
    anomaly_sounds["gravity"] = dummy_stream
    anomaly_sounds["chemical"] = dummy_stream
    anomaly_sounds["radiation"] = dummy_stream
    
    # Звуки мутантов
    mutant_sounds["bloodsucker"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["flesh"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["snork"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["pseudodog"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["controller"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["poltergeist"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["chimera"] = dummy_stream
    mutant_sounds["zombie"] = dummy_stream
    
    # Звуки шагов
    footstep_sounds["grass"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["sand"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["stone"] = dummy_stream
    footstep_sounds["water"] = dummy_stream
    
    pass # print("Заглушки звуков созданы", "SoundManager")


# ==================== МУЗЫКА ====================

func play_music(track_name: String, fade_time: float = 1.0):
    if not music_tracks.has(track_name):
        pass # print("Неизвестный трек: " + track_name, "SoundManager")
        return
    
    var track = music_tracks[track_name]
    if not track:
        return
    
    if _current_music_track == track_name and _is_music_playing:
        return
    
    _target_music = track
    _music_fade_duration = fade_time
    _music_fade_timer = fade_time
    _current_music_track = track_name
    
    music_changed.emit(track_name)
    pass # print("Смена музыки на: " + track_name, "SoundManager")


func stop_music(fade_time: float = 1.0):
    _music_fade_duration = fade_time
    _music_fade_timer = fade_time
    _target_music = null
    _current_music_track = ""
    pass # print("Музыка останавливается", "SoundManager")


func _process(delta):
    # Плавное затухание/нарастание музыки
    if _music_fade_timer > 0:
        _music_fade_timer -= delta
        var t = 1.0 - (_music_fade_timer / _music_fade_duration)
        
        if _target_music:
            # Нарастание
            if not _is_music_playing:
                _music_player.stream = _target_music
                _music_player.play()
                _is_music_playing = true
            
            _music_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(music_volume * ease(t, 0.5))
        else:
            # Затухание
            _music_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(music_volume * (1.0 - ease(t, 0.5)))
            
            if _music_fade_timer <= 0:
                _music_player.stop()
                _is_music_playing = false


# ==================== ЗВУКИ ====================

func play_sound(sound_name: String, volume_mod: float = 1.0, pitch_mod: float = 1.0):
    var sound = _find_sound(sound_name)
    if not sound:
        # Вместо ошибки просто возвращаемся - заглушки уже есть
        return
    
    var player = _get_free_sfx_player()
    if not player:
        return
    
    player.stream = sound
    player.volume_db = linear_to_db(sfx_volume * volume_mod)
    player.pitch_scale = pitch_mod
    player.play()
    
    sound_played.emit(sound_name)
    # Убираем лишний лог для часто вызываемых звуков
    if not sound_name.begins_with("ui_"):
        pass # print("Звук воспроизведен: " + sound_name, "SoundManager")


func _find_sound(sound_name: String) -> AudioStream:
    if footstep_sounds.has(sound_name):
        return footstep_sounds[sound_name]
    if ambient_sounds.has(sound_name):
        return ambient_sounds[sound_name]
    if anomaly_sounds.has(sound_name):
        return anomaly_sounds[sound_name]
    if mutant_sounds.has(sound_name):
        return mutant_sounds[sound_name]
    
    return null


func _get_free_sfx_player() -> AudioStreamPlayer:
    for player in _sfx_players:
        if not player.playing:
            return player
    return _sfx_players[0]


# ==================== СПЕЦИФИЧЕСКИЕ ЗВУКИ ====================

func play_footstep(terrain_type: String):
    # Варианты шагов: случайный клип + случайный питч, чтобы не тикало метрономом
    if footstep_variants.has(terrain_type):
        var variants: Array = footstep_variants[terrain_type]
        var sound: AudioStream = variants[randi() % variants.size()]
        var player = _get_free_sfx_player()
        if player and sound:
            player.stream = sound
            player.volume_db = linear_to_db(sfx_volume * 0.5)
            player.pitch_scale = randf_range(0.9, 1.1)
            player.play()
        return
    play_sound(terrain_type, 0.5, randf_range(0.9, 1.1))


## Случайный вариант шага для позиционного плеера сущности (3D-звук)
func get_footstep_stream(surface: String) -> AudioStream:
    if footstep_variants.has(surface):
        var variants: Array = footstep_variants[surface]
        return variants[randi() % variants.size()]
    if footstep_sounds.has(surface):
        return footstep_sounds[surface]
    return null


## Рык мутанта: ключи пака; пёс падает на псевдопса
func play_mutant_spawn_sound(mutant_type: String):
    var key := mutant_type
    if key == "dog_mutant":
        key = "pseudodog"
    play_mutant_sound(key)


func play_anomaly_sound(anomaly_type: String):
    var sound_key = ""
    match anomaly_type:
        "electric_anomaly", "electric_tesla", "electric":
            sound_key = "electric"
        "heat_anomaly", "thermal_steam", "thermal_comet", "heat":
            sound_key = "thermal"
        "gravity_vortex", "gravity_lift", "gravity_whirlwind", "gravity":
            sound_key = "gravity"
        "chemical_gas", "chemical_acid_cloud", "chemical_jelly", "chemical":
            sound_key = "chemical"
        "radiation_hotspot", "radiation":
            sound_key = "radiation"
    
    if sound_key and anomaly_sounds.has(sound_key):
        play_sound(sound_key, 0.7)


func play_mutant_sound(mutant_type: String):
    if mutant_sounds.has(mutant_type):
        play_sound(mutant_type, 0.8, randf_range(0.9, 1.1))


func play_ui_click():
    play_sound("ui_click", 0.6)


func play_pulse_warning():
    play_sound("pulse_warning", 1.0)


# ==================== НАСТРОЙКИ ====================

func set_master_volume(value: float):
    master_volume = clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0)
    _update_volumes()
    pass # print("Громкость master: " + str(value), "SoundManager")


func set_music_volume(value: float):
    music_volume = clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0)
    _music_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(music_volume)


func set_sfx_volume(value: float):
    sfx_volume = clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0)
    _update_volumes()


func _update_volumes():
    _music_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(music_volume * master_volume)
    _ambient_player.volume_db = linear_to_db(sfx_volume * master_volume * 0.5)
    for player in _sfx_players:
        player.volume_db = linear_to_db(sfx_volume * master_volume)


func get_current_music() -> String:
    return _current_music_track


func is_playing() -> bool:
    return _is_music_playing

# Статистика
var _stalkers_killed: int = 0
var _artifacts_stolen: int = 0
var _mutants_spawned: int = 0

# Кеш для монолита
var _last_monolith_check: float = 0.0
var _cached_monolith: Node = null
const MONOLITH_CACHE_TIME: float = 1.0

# Для предотвращения спавна в одной точке
var _last_spawn_positions: Array[Vector3] = []
# Наградные мутанты (гача/вехи выживания): спавнятся бесплатно у монолита на старте волны
var reward_mutants: Array[String] = []
const MIN_SPAWN_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_STALKERS: float = 10.0

# ВЫСОТА СПАВНА - origin тела сталкера на 1.8 над землёй
# (капсула высотой 1.8 со смещением -0.9 в base_stalker.tscn занимает диапазон
# origin-1.8 .. origin, поэтому на земле Y=0 origin тела = 1.8)
const SPAWN_HEIGHT: float = 1.8


func _ready():
	add_to_group("spawn_manager")
	
	# Заполняем сцены мутантов
	mutant_scenes = {
		"dog_mutant": preload("res://entities/mutants/dog_mutant.tscn"),
		"flesh": preload("res://entities/mutants/flesh.tscn"),
		"snork_mutant": preload("res://entities/mutants/snork_mutant.tscn"),
		"pseudodog": preload("res://entities/mutants/pseudodog.tscn"),
		"controller_mutant": preload("res://entities/mutants/controller_mutant.tscn"),
		"poltergeist": preload("res://entities/mutants/poltergeist.tscn"),
		"bloodsucker": preload("res://entities/mutants/bloodsucker.tscn"),
		"chimera": preload("res://entities/mutants/chimera.tscn"),
		"pseudogiant": preload("res://entities/mutants/pseudogiant.tscn"),
		"zombie": preload("res://entities/mutants/zombie.tscn")
	}
	
	# print("SpawnManager инициализирован")


func _get_monolith() -> Node:
	var current_time = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
	if current_time - _last_monolith_check > MONOLITH_CACHE_TIME or not is_instance_valid(_cached_monolith):
		_cached_monolith = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("monolith")
		_last_monolith_check = current_time
	return _cached_monolith


# ==================== УПРАВЛЕНИЕ ====================

func start_spawning():
	is_active = true
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout
	if not is_active:
		return
	_start_wave()
	# print("Спавн сталкеров запущен")


func stop_spawning():
	is_active = false
	# print("Спавн сталкеров остановлен")


func force_wave():
	if is_active and not is_spawning:
		_start_wave()


func set_difficulty(difficulty: float):
	_difficulty = difficulty
	# print("Сложность спавна: " + str(difficulty))


# ==================== ВОЛНЫ СТАЛКЕРОВ ====================

func _start_wave():
	if is_spawning or not is_active:
		return

	# В выживании волны не кончаются
	if not endless_mode and current_wave >= max_waves:
		return

	is_spawning = true
	current_wave += 1

	_spawn_reward_mutants()

	var stalkers_to_spawn = _calculate_stalker_count()
	wave_started.emit(current_wave, stalkers_to_spawn)
	# print("Волна " + str(current_wave) + " начата, сталкеров: " + str(stalkers_to_spawn))

	var spawned = 0
	for i in range(stalkers_to_spawn):
		if _spawn_stalker():
			spawned += 1
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.3).timeout

	is_spawning = false
	wave_ended.emit(current_wave, spawned)
	# print("Волна " + str(current_wave) + " завершена, создано: " + str(spawned))

	if not endless_mode and current_wave >= max_waves:
		_watch_field_clear()
	else:
		_schedule_next_wave()


func _schedule_next_wave():
	"""Пауза между волнами, затем следующая волна"""
	if not is_active:
		return
	break_started.emit(current_wave, wave_break)
	# print("Пауза между волнами: " + str(wave_break) + " с. Следующая волна: " + str(current_wave + 1))
	await get_tree().create_timer(wave_break).timeout
	if not is_active:
		return
	_start_wave()


func _watch_field_clear():
	"""Последняя волна заспавнена: победа, когда игрок перебьёт всех сталкеров"""
	while is_active and get_stalker_count() > 0:
		await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout
	if is_active:
		# print("Все волны отбиты, сталкеров не осталось!")
		all_waves_cleared.emit()


func queue_reward_mutant(mutant_type: String):
	"""Наградный мутант (гача/веха): бесплатно вступит в бой на старте волны"""
	reward_mutants.append(mutant_type)
	# print("SpawnManager: награда - ", mutant_type, " вступит в бой со следующей волной")


func _spawn_reward_mutants():
	while not reward_mutants.is_empty():
		var type: String = reward_mutants.pop_front()
		var angle = randf() * TAU
		var dist = randf_range(45.0, 70.0)
		var ray = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(
			Vector3(cos(angle) * dist, 30.0, sin(angle) * dist),
			Vector3(cos(angle) * dist, -30.0, sin(angle) * dist), 1)
		var hit = get_viewport().get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(ray)
		var pos = hit.get("position", Vector3(cos(angle) * dist, 0.0, sin(angle) * dist)) + Vector3(0, 1.8, 0)
		var mutant = spawn_mutant(type, pos, 0.0)
		if mutant:
			pass
			# print("SpawnManager: наградный мутант вступил в бой: ", type)


func _calculate_stalker_count() -> int:
	var base = randi_range(min_stalkers_per_wave, max_stalkers_per_wave)
	return ceil(base * _difficulty)


func _spawn_stalker() -> bool:
	var scene = _get_stalker_scene_by_difficulty()
	if not scene:
		# print("Нет сцены для сталкера")
		return false
	
	var pos = _get_spawn_position()
	if pos == Vector3.ZERO:
		pos = _get_fallback_spawn_position()
		if pos == Vector3.ZERO:
			# print("Не удалось найти позицию для спавна")
			return false
	
	var stalker = scene.instantiate()
	stalker.position = pos

	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(stalker)

	# Масштабирование кампании: после add_child - статы задаёт _ready() ранга
	if campaign_hp_mult != 1.0 or campaign_damage_mult != 1.0 or campaign_speed_mult != 1.0:
		if stalker.has_method("apply_campaign_scaling"):
			stalker.apply_campaign_scaling(campaign_hp_mult, campaign_damage_mult, campaign_speed_mult)

	var monolith = _get_monolith()
	if monolith:
		var dir = (monolith.global_position - pos).normalized()
		stalker.look_at(pos + dir, Vector3.UP)
	
	if stalker.has_signal("died"):
		stalker.died.connect(_on_stalker_died)
	
	active_stalkers.append(stalker)
	
	var stalker_type = "novice"
	if scene == stalker_scenes.get("veteran"):
		stalker_type = "veteran"
	elif scene == stalker_scenes.get("master"):
		stalker_type = "master"
	
	stalker_spawned.emit(stalker, stalker_type)
	# print("Сталкер заспавнен: " + stalker_type + " на позиции " + str(pos))
	
	return true


func _get_stalker_scene_by_difficulty() -> PackedScene:
	# Кампания: состав рангов задаётся весами уровня, а не порогами сложности
	if not rank_weights.is_empty():
		return _get_stalker_scene_by_weights()

	var rand_val = randf()

	if _difficulty < 1.2:
		if rand_val < 0.6: return stalker_scenes.get("novice")
		elif rand_val < 0.9: return stalker_scenes.get("veteran")
		else: return stalker_scenes.get("master")
	elif _difficulty < 1.5:
		if rand_val < 0.4: return stalker_scenes.get("novice")
		elif rand_val < 0.8: return stalker_scenes.get("veteran")
		else: return stalker_scenes.get("master")
	elif _difficulty < 2.0:
		if rand_val < 0.3: return stalker_scenes.get("novice")
		elif rand_val < 0.7: return stalker_scenes.get("veteran")
		else: return stalker_scenes.get("master")
	else:
		if rand_val < 0.2: return stalker_scenes.get("novice")
		elif rand_val < 0.6: return stalker_scenes.get("veteran")
		else: return stalker_scenes.get("master")


func _get_stalker_scene_by_weights() -> PackedScene:
	var novice: float = float(rank_weights.get("novice", 0.0))
	var veteran: float = float(rank_weights.get("veteran", 0.0))
	var master: float = float(rank_weights.get("master", 0.0))
	var total: float = novice + veteran + master

	if total <= 0.0:
		return stalker_scenes.get("novice")

	var roll: float = randf() * total
	if roll < novice:
		return stalker_scenes.get("novice")
	elif roll < novice + veteran:
		return stalker_scenes.get("veteran")
	return stalker_scenes.get("master")


func _get_spawn_position() -> Vector3:
	var monolith = _get_monolith()
	if not monolith:
		return Vector3.ZERO
	
	for attempt in range(20):
		var angle = randf() * TAU
		var distance = min_spawn_distance + randf() * (spawn_radius - min_spawn_distance)
		var pos = monolith.global_position + Vector3(cos(angle) * distance, 100, sin(angle) * distance)
		
		var space = get_viewport().get_world_3d().direct_space_state
		var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.new()
		query.from = pos
		query.to = pos + Vector3(0, -200, 0)
		query.collision_mask = 1
		query.hit_from_inside = true
		
		var result = space.intersect_ray(query)
		if result:
			# СТАЛКЕР НА ВЫСОТЕ SPAWN_HEIGHT НАД РЕЛЬЕФОМ
			var ground_pos = Vector3(result.position.x, result.position.y + SPAWN_HEIGHT, result.position.z)
			
			var too_close = false
			for existing_pos in _last_spawn_positions:
				if ground_pos.distance_to(existing_pos) < MIN_SPAWN_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_STALKERS:
					too_close = true
					break
			
			if not too_close:
				_last_spawn_positions.append(ground_pos)
				if _last_spawn_positions.size() > 10:
					_last_spawn_positions.pop_front()
				return ground_pos
	
	return Vector3.ZERO


func _get_fallback_spawn_position() -> Vector3:
	var monolith = _get_monolith()
	if not monolith:
		return Vector3.ZERO
	
	for angle_offset in range(0, 8):
		var angle = (randf() + angle_offset) * TAU / 4
		var distance = min_spawn_distance + 5.0
		var pos = monolith.global_position + Vector3(cos(angle) * distance, 100, sin(angle) * distance)
		
		var space = get_viewport().get_world_3d().direct_space_state
		var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.new()
		query.from = pos
		query.to = pos + Vector3(0, -200, 0)
		query.collision_mask = 1
		
		var result = space.intersect_ray(query)
		if result:
			var ground_pos = Vector3(result.position.x, result.position.y + SPAWN_HEIGHT, result.position.z)
			
			var too_close = false
			for existing_pos in _last_spawn_positions:
				if ground_pos.distance_to(existing_pos) < MIN_SPAWN_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_STALKERS:
					too_close = true
					break
			
			if not too_close:
				_last_spawn_positions.append(ground_pos)
				if _last_spawn_positions.size() > 10:
					_last_spawn_positions.pop_front()
				return ground_pos
	
	for i in range(5):
		var fallback_pos = monolith.global_position + Vector3(10 + i * 5, 0, 10 + i * 5)
		return Vector3(fallback_pos.x, SPAWN_HEIGHT, fallback_pos.z)
	
	return Vector3(monolith.global_position.x, SPAWN_HEIGHT, monolith.global_position.z)


func _on_stalker_died(stalker: Node):
	if stalker in active_stalkers:
		active_stalkers.erase(stalker)
	
	var return_value = 8.0
	if stalker.has_method("get_stalker_type"):
		var stalker_type = stalker.get_stalker_type()
		return_value = stalker_biomass_returns.get(stalker_type, 8.0)
	
	_stalkers_killed += 1
	
	stalker_died.emit(stalker, return_value)
	# (лог отключён)
	# Биомассу начисляет BaseStalker._on_died -> ZoneController.on_stalker_died


# ==================== МУТАНТЫ ====================

func spawn_mutant(mutant_type: String, position: Vector3, _biomass_cost: float) -> Node:
	if not mutant_scenes.has(mutant_type):
		# print("Неизвестный тип мутанта: " + mutant_type)
		return null
	
	var scene = mutant_scenes[mutant_type]
	if not scene:
		# print("Сцена не найдена для мутанта: " + mutant_type)
		return null
	
	var mutant = scene.instantiate()
	# Спавн не за периметром Зоны
	position.x = clampf(position.x, -Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT, Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT)
	position.z = clampf(position.z, -Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT, Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT)
	mutant.position = position
	
	# Звёздность типа: множитель статов + уровень для подписи
	var stars := maxi(int(mutant_stars.get(mutant_type, 1)), 1)
	var star_mult := LabData.get_star_stat_mult(stars)
	if stars > 1 and mutant.has_method("set_star_level"):
		mutant.set_star_level(stars)
	
	var hp_mult := health_multiplier * star_mult
	var dmg_mult := damage_multiplier * star_mult
	if hp_mult != 1.0 and mutant.has_method("set_health_multiplier"):
		mutant.set_health_multiplier(hp_mult)
	if dmg_mult != 1.0 and mutant.has_method("set_damage_multiplier"):
		mutant.set_damage_multiplier(dmg_mult)
	
	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(mutant)
	active_mutants.append(mutant)
	_mutants_spawned += 1
	
	mutant_spawned.emit(mutant, mutant_type)
	var _star_note := " [%d★ x%.1f]" % [stars, star_mult] if stars > 1 else ""
	# print("Мутант заспавнен: " + mutant_type + " на позиции " + str(position) + star_note)
	
	return mutant


func remove_mutant(mutant: Node):
	if mutant in active_mutants:
		active_mutants.erase(mutant)
	if is_instance_valid(mutant):
		mutant.queue_free()


func get_mutant_cost(mutant_type: String) -> float:
	var base_cost = mutant_costs.get(mutant_type, 20.0)
	return base_cost * cost_multiplier


# ==================== ГЕТТЕРЫ ====================

func get_active_stalkers() -> Array[Node]:
	return active_stalkers.filter(func(s): return is_instance_valid(s))


func get_active_mutants() -> Array[Node]:
	return active_mutants.filter(func(m): return is_instance_valid(m))


func get_stalker_count() -> int:
	return active_stalkers.size()


func get_mutant_count() -> int:
	return active_mutants.size()


func get_stalkers_killed() -> int:
	return _stalkers_killed


func get_artifacts_stolen() -> int:
	return _artifacts_stolen


func get_total_mutants_spawned() -> int:
	return _mutants_spawned


# ==================== СТАТИСТИКА ====================

func record_artifact_stolen():
	_artifacts_stolen += 1


func reset_statistics():
	_stalkers_killed = 0
	_artifacts_stolen = 0
	_mutants_spawned = 0
	# print("Статистика спавна сброшена")


# ==================== НАСТРОЙКИ ====================

func set_health_multiplier(value: float):
	health_multiplier = value
	# print("Множитель здоровья мутантов: " + str(value))


func set_damage_multiplier(value: float):
	damage_multiplier = value
	# print("Множитель урона мутантов: " + str(value))


func set_cost_multiplier(value: float):
	cost_multiplier = value
	# print("Множитель стоимости мутантов: " + str(value))


## Звёздность из коллекции (тип -> звёзды): применяется к спавнящимся мутантам
func set_mutant_stars(stars: Dictionary):
	mutant_stars = stars.duplicate()
	if not mutant_stars.is_empty():
		var starred := []
		for type in mutant_stars:
			if int(mutant_stars[type]) > 1:
				starred.append("%s:%d★" % [type, int(mutant_stars[type])])
		if not starred.is_empty():
			pass
			# print("Звёздность мутантов: " + ", ".join(starred))


# ==================== ПАРАМЕТРЫ КАМПАНИИ ====================

## Весовой состав рангов из кампании: mix = [новички, ветераны, мастера] в процентах
func set_rank_weights(mix: Array):
	if mix.size() < 3:
		# print("set_rank_weights: ожидается массив из 3 процентов, получено: " + str(mix))
		return
	rank_weights = {
		"novice": float(mix[0]),
		"veteran": float(mix[1]),
		"master": float(mix[2])
	}
	# print("Состав рангов: н/в/м = %d/%d/%d%%" % [int(mix[0]), int(mix[1]), int(mix[2])])


## Множители статов врагов для текущего уровня кампании
func set_campaign_scaling(hp_mult: float, damage_mult: float, speed_mult: float):
	campaign_hp_mult = hp_mult
	campaign_damage_mult = damage_mult
	campaign_speed_mult = speed_mult
	# print("Масштаб кампании: HP x%.2f, урон x%.2f, скорость x%.2f" % [hp_mult, damage_mult, speed_mult])

# Анимированные модели мутантов — источники и лицензии

Все модели в этой папке — **CC0 / Public Domain** (Quaternius, через poly.pizza).
Разрешено любое использование, включая коммерческое, указание авторства не требуется,
но мы его сохраняем здесь из вежливости.

Источник: https://poly.pizza (автор Quaternius, https://quaternius.com)
Формат: GLB (FBX2glTF v0.9.7), скелет + анимации внутри каждой модели.

| Файл в игре | Исходная модель | Кто играет в игре | Клипы |
|---|---|---|---|
| dog_mutant_anim.glb | Husky | Плоть-пёс (dog_mutant) | Attack, Death, Eating, Gallop, Idle, Idle_2, Walk, Jump_ToIdle, HitReact x2 |
| pseudodog_anim.glb | Shiba Inu | Псевдопёс (pseudodog) | тот же набор |
| chimera_anim.glb | Wolf | Химера (chimera) | тот же набор |
| flesh_anim.glb | Bull | Плоть (flesh) | Attack_Headbutt, Attack_Kick, Death, Gallop, Idle, Walk ... |
| snork_anim.glb | Orc | Снорк (snork) | Walk, Run, Punch, Death, Idle, HitReact ... |
| zombie_anim.glb | Orc Enemy | Зомби (zombie) | Walk, Bite_Front, Death, Idle, Jump |
| pseudogiant_anim.glb | Yeti | Псевдогигант (pseudogiant) | Walk, Bite_Front, Death, Idle, Dance, Jump |
| controller_anim.glb | Alien | Контролёр (controller) | Walk, Run, Punch, Death, Idle, HitReact ... |
| poltergeist_anim.glb | Ghost | Полтергейст (poltergeist) | Flying_Idle, Fast_Flying, Headbutt, Death, HitReact |

Страницы паков:
- Animated Animal Pack: https://poly.pizza/bundle/Animated-Animal-Pack-ILAPXeUYiS
- Ultimate Monsters Bundle: https://poly.pizza/bundle/Ultimate-Monsters-Bundle-5oyGWAmOB6

Порядок импорта в Godot: клипы получают имена вида «AnimalArmature|Walk» —
их подбирает по суффиксам проигрыватель в `base_mutant.gd`, вручную ничего
подключать не нужно.

# models/props — уличные пропсы для карты Припяти

23 low-poly `.glb` с материалами, реальный масштаб в метрах, origin в
основании, машины вытянуты по Z. Доставка: агент-подготовщик (задание 2
`COMMANDS.md`, `inbox/_done/pripyat_props/` — там же README с габаритами).
Раскладчик: `terrain/pripyat_props.gd`, плотности: `data/pripyat_props_data.gd`.

Модификация источников — только нормализация (масштаб/origin узлом-обёрткой
`normalized` внутри glb; геометрия и материалы не менялись).

## Kenney (kenney.nl) — CC0

Паки: Car Kit, Nature Kit, Graveyard Kit.
Лицензия CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

| car_body_02.glb | suv | Car Kit — kenney.nl/assets/car-kit |
| car_body_03.glb | taxi | Car Kit — kenney.nl/assets/car-kit |

@tool
extends EditorScript

func _run():
	var output = ""
	
	# project.godot
	output += "=== project.godot ===\n"
	output += _read_file("res://project.godot")
	output += "\n\n"
	
	# Структура папок
	output += "=== СТРУКТУРА ПАПОК ===\n"
	output += _get_folder_structure("res://")
	output += "\n\n"
	
	# Все .gd файлы
	output += "=== ВСЕ GD ФАЙЛЫ ===\n"
	var gd_files = []
	_collect_files("res://scripts/", ".gd", gd_files)
	for file in gd_files:
		output += "\n--- " + file + " ---\n"
		output += _read_file(file)
		output += "\n"
	
	# Все .tscn файлы (основные)
	output += "=== ВАЖНЫЕ TSCN ФАЙЛЫ ===\n"
	var tscn_files = []
	_collect_files("res://scenes/main/", ".tscn", tscn_files)
	_collect_files("res://scenes/lab/", ".tscn", tscn_files)
	_collect_files("res://scenes/ui/", ".tscn", tscn_files)
	for file in tscn_files:
		output += "\n--- " + file + " ---\n"
		output += _read_file(file)
		output += "\n"
	
	# Сохраняем
	var file = FileAccess.open("res://project_export.txt", FileAccess.WRITE)
	file.store_string(output)
	print("✅ Экспорт завершён! Файл: res://project_export.txt")

func _collect_files(path: String, ext: String, files: Array):
	var dir = DirAccess.open(path)
	if not dir:
		return
	dir.list_dir_begin()
	var file_name = dir.get_next()
	while file_name != "":
		if dir.current_is_dir() and file_name != "." and file_name != "..":
			_collect_files(path + file_name + "/", ext, files)
		elif file_name.ends_with(ext):
			files.append(path + file_name)
		file_name = dir.get_next()

func _read_file(path: String) -> String:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		return "Файл не найден: " + path + "\n"
	var file = FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	return file.get_as_text()

func _get_folder_structure(path: String, prefix: String = "") -> String:
	var result = ""
	var dir = DirAccess.open(path)
	if not dir:
		return "Не удалось открыть " + path + "\n"
	
	dir.list_dir_begin()
	var file_name = dir.get_next()
	while file_name != "":
		if file_name == "." or file_name == "..":
			file_name = dir.get_next()
			continue
		if dir.current_is_dir():
			result += prefix + "📁 " + file_name + "/\n"
			result += _get_folder_structure(path + file_name + "/", prefix + "    ")
		else:
			result += prefix + "📄 " + file_name + "\n"
		file_name = dir.get_next()
	return result

# scripts/game_camera.gd
extends Camera3D

## ПК: WASD-полёт + осмотр мышью (как раньше, без изменений).
## Мобилка: RTS-камера — пан пальцем с инерцией («палец тянет карту»),
## pinch-зум, кнопки +/− у миникарты, двойной тап — центр на монолите,
## тап по земле -> Signals.ground_tapped (режим «тап = ставить» из HUD).

@export var move_speed: float = 20.0
@export var look_speed: float = 0.002

var mouse_captured: bool = false
var rotation_x: float = 0.0
var rotation_y: float = 0.0

# --- Мобильный RTS-режим ---
var touch_mode: bool = false
const RTS_PITCH: float = -1.05            # ~60 градусов вниз
const RTS_YAW: float = 0.0                # север вверх, как на миникарте
const ZOOM_MIN: float = 25.0
const ZOOM_MAX: float = 150.0
const TERRAIN_MARGIN: float = 8.0         # не нырять в рельеф при пане по холмам
const TOUCH_SLOP: float = 14.0            # px: меньше - тап, больше - пан
const TAP_MAX_TIME: float = 0.35          # сек: дольше - это пан
const DOUBLE_TAP_TIME: float = 0.35
const INERTIA_DECAY: float = 0.04         # остаток скорости через 1 сек

var _touches: Dictionary = {}             # index -> Vector2 (последняя позиция)
var _pinch_dist0: float = 0.0
var _pinch_height0: float = 0.0
var _pan_velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO # px/сек, для инерции после отпускания
var _drag_total: float = 0.0
var _press_time: float = -10.0
var _last_drag_time: float = 0.0
var _last_tap_time: float = -10.0
var _last_tap_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO


func _ready():
        touch_mode = DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available()
        if touch_mode:
                _setup_mobile_rts()
        else:
                Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)
                mouse_captured = true


func _exit_tree():
        # При выходе из забега (лаборатория/меню - UI-сцены) курсор должен вернуться
        Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)


func _input(event):
        # ПК-ветка: осмотр мышью + ESC переключает захват курсора (как раньше).
        # На мобилке не мешаем: там своя обработка в _unhandled_input.
        if touch_mode:
                return
        if event is InputEventMouseMotion and mouse_captured:
                rotation_y -= event.relative.x * look_speed
                rotation_x -= event.relative.y * look_speed
                rotation_x = clamp(rotation_x, -1.4, 1.4)

                rotation.y = rotation_y
                rotation.x = rotation_x

        if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
                if mouse_captured:
                        Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)
                        mouse_captured = false
                else:
                        Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)
                        mouse_captured = true


# ==================== МОБИЛЬНЫЙ RTS-РЕЖИМ ====================

func _setup_mobile_rts() -> void:
        var monolith: Node3D = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("monolith")
        var center: Vector3 = monolith.global_position if monolith else Vector3.ZERO
        global_position = center + Vector3(0, 65, 45)
        rotation = Vector3(RTS_PITCH, RTS_YAW, 0)
        _make_zoom_buttons()


func _make_zoom_buttons() -> void:
        # Две круглые кнопки +/− над миникартой (справа внизу). Только для тача.
        var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
        layer.name = "TouchZoom"
        layer.layer = 2
        add_child(layer)
        for i in 2:
                var b := Button.new()
                b.text = "+" if i == 0 else "−"
                b.anchor_left = 1.0
                b.anchor_right = 1.0
                b.anchor_top = 1.0
                b.anchor_bottom = 1.0
                b.offset_left = -104.0 if i == 0 else -56.0
                b.offset_right = -60.0 if i == 0 else -12.0
                b.offset_top = -320.0
                b.offset_bottom = -276.0
                b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
                b.pressed.connect(_on_zoom_button.bind(1 if i == 0 else -1))
                layer.add_child(b)


func _on_zoom_button(dir: int) -> void:
        var target := clampf(global_position.y + dir * 20.0, ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
        var tw := create_tween()
        tw.tween_property(self, "global_position:y", target, 0.18)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        # _unhandled_input: тапы по кнопкам/панелям HUD сюда не доходят
        if not touch_mode:
                return

        if event is InputEventScreenTouch:
                if event.pressed:
                        _touches[event.index] = event.position
                        if _touches.size() == 1:
                                _press_time = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
                                _drag_total = 0.0
                                _pan_velocity = Vector2.ZERO   # тап гасит инерцию
                                _last_drag_time = _press_time
                        elif _touches.size() == 2:
                                var points: Array = _touches.values()
                                _pinch_dist0 = points[0].distance_to(points[1])
                                _pinch_height0 = global_position.y
                else:
                        var was_single: bool = _touches.size() == 1 and _touches.has(event.index)
                        _touches.erase(event.index)
                        if was_single:
                                _maybe_tap(event.position)
                        if _touches.size() == 1:
                                # после pinch оставшийся палец заново якорит пан
                                _press_time = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
                                _drag_total = 0.0
                                _last_drag_time = _press_time

        elif event is InputEventScreenDrag:
                if not _touches.has(event.index):
                        return
                _touches[event.index] = event.position
                if _touches.size() == 1:
                        _drag_total += event.relative.length()
                        var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
                        var dt: float = maxf(now - _last_drag_time, 1.0 / 120.0)
                        _last_drag_time = now
                        var inst_v: Vector2 = event.relative / dt
                        _pan_velocity = _pan_velocity.lerp(inst_v, 0.35)
                        _pan_by_pixels(event.relative)
                elif _touches.size() == 2:
                        var points: Array = _touches.values()
                        var d: float = points[0].distance_to(points[1])
                        if _pinch_dist0 > 1.0:
                                var h: float = clampf(_pinch_height0 * _pinch_dist0 / maxf(d, 1.0), ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
                                global_position.y = h


func _maybe_tap(pos: Vector2) -> void:
        var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
        if now - _press_time > TAP_MAX_TIME or _drag_total > TOUCH_SLOP:
                return

        # В режиме кисти (HUD) двойной тап - просто вторая постановка
        var placing: bool = false
        var zc: Node = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("zone_controller")
        if zc and str(zc.get("_pending_placement")) != "":
                placing = true

        if not placing and now - _last_tap_time < DOUBLE_TAP_TIME and pos.distance_to(_last_tap_pos) < 48.0:
                _last_tap_time = -10.0
                _center_on_monolith()
                return

        _last_tap_time = now
        _last_tap_pos = pos

        var hit: Vector3 = _raycast_ground(pos)
        if hit.x != INF:
                Signals.ground_tapped.emit(hit)


func _center_on_monolith() -> void:
        var monolith: Node3D = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("monolith")
        if not monolith:
                return
        var c: Vector3 = monolith.global_position
        var dir: Vector3 = (global_position - c)
        dir.y = 0.0
        if dir.length() < 1.0:
                dir = Vector3(0, 0, 45)  # смотрим с юга
        var dist: float = clampf(global_position.y * 0.7, 30.0, 70.0)
        var target: Vector3 = c + dir.normalized() * dist
        target.y = maxf(global_position.y, ZOOM_MIN)
        var tw := create_tween()
        tw.tween_property(self, "global_position", target, 0.3).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)


func _pan_by_pixels(pixel_delta: Vector2) -> void:
        var px2world: float = _ground_pixels_to_world()
        var right: Vector3 = global_transform.basis.x
        var fwd: Vector3 = global_transform.basis.z * -1.0
        right.y = 0.0
        fwd.y = 0.0
        if right.length() > 0.01:
                right = right.normalized()
        if fwd.length() > 0.01:
                fwd = fwd.normalized()
        # «Палец тянет карту»: контент следует за пальцем
        global_position += (right * -pixel_delta.x + fwd * pixel_delta.y) * px2world
        _clamp_mobile_position()


func _ground_pixels_to_world() -> float:
        # Метров мира на пиксель на текущей высоте (с учётом наклона)
        var vsize: float = float(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y)
        var world_h: float = 2.0 * global_position.y * tan(deg_to_rad(fov) * 0.5)
        var tilt: float = maxf(sin(-rotation.x), 0.4)
        return world_h / maxf(vsize, 1.0) / tilt


func _raycast_ground(screen_pos: Vector2) -> Vector3:
        var origin: Vector3 = project_ray_origin(screen_pos)
        var dir: Vector3 = project_ray_normal(screen_pos)
        var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(origin, origin + dir * 500.0, 1)
        var hit: Dictionary = get_viewport().get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)
        if hit and hit.has("position"):
                return hit.position
        return Vector3.INF


func _clamp_mobile_position() -> void:
        global_position.x = clampf(global_position.x, -Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT, Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT)
        global_position.z = clampf(global_position.z, -Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT, Helpers.WORLD_LIMIT)
        global_position.y = clampf(global_position.y, ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
        var terrain: Node = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("terrain_generator")
        if terrain and terrain.has_method("get_terrain_height"):
                var min_y: float = terrain.get_terrain_height(global_position.x, global_position.z) + TERRAIN_MARGIN
                if global_position.y < min_y:
                        global_position.y = min_y


func _process(delta):
        if touch_mode:
                # Инерция пана после отпускания пальца
                if _touches.is_empty() and _pan_velocity.length() > 8.0:
                        _pan_by_pixels(_pan_velocity * delta)
                        _pan_velocity *= pow(INERTIA_DECAY, delta)
                return

        var input_dir = Vector3.ZERO

        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W):
                input_dir -= transform.basis.z
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S):
                input_dir += transform.basis.z
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A):
                input_dir -= transform.basis.x
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D):
                input_dir += transform.basis.x
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE):
                input_dir += Vector3.UP
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT):
                input_dir -= Vector3.UP

        if input_dir.length() > 0:
                input_dir = input_dir.normalized()
                global_position += input_dir * move_speed * delta
                # Не ныряем под рельеф: осмотр снизу ломает картинку (задние грани)
                var terrain = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("terrain_generator")
                var min_y := 2.0
                if terrain:
                        min_y = terrain.get_terrain_height(global_position.x, global_position.z) + 3.0
                if global_position.y < min_y:
                        global_position.y = min_y

shader_type canvas_item;
// "Grim Zone" post effect: desaturation, sickly tint, washed blacks,
// vignette, animated film grain, subtle flicker. Attach to a full-rect
// ColorRect inside a top CanvasLayer. All uniforms are safe to animate.

uniform float desaturation : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.32;
uniform float tint_strength : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.22;
uniform vec4 tint_color : source_color = vec4(0.55, 0.60, 0.48, 1.0);
uniform float wash : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.45; // lifted, faded blacks
uniform float vignette_strength : hint_range(0.0, 3.0) = 1.1;
uniform float vignette_radius : hint_range(0.1, 1.5) = 0.62;
uniform float grain_amount : hint_range(0.0, 0.4) = 0.065;
uniform float grain_scale = 220.0;
uniform float grain_speed = 1.5;
uniform float flicker_amount : hint_range(0.0, 0.1) = 0.02;

uniform sampler2D screen_tex : hint_screen_texture, filter_nearest;

float hash(vec2 p) {
	return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453123);
}

void fragment() {
	vec3 col = texture(screen_tex, SCREEN_UV).rgb;

	// desaturate towards luminance, then push into a sickly tint
	float lum = dot(col, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
	col = mix(col, vec3(lum), desaturation);
	col = mix(col, tint_color.rgb * (lum * 0.9 + 0.1), tint_strength);

	// washed-out blacks / faded film
	col = mix(col, col * 0.75 + vec3(0.06, 0.062, 0.055), wash);

	// vignette (aspect-correct)
	vec2 d = SCREEN_UV - vec2(0.5);
	d.x *= SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE.x / SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE.y;
	float vig = smoothstep(vignette_radius + 0.45, vignette_radius - 0.35, length(d));
	col *= clamp(mix(1.0, vig, clamp(vignette_strength, 0.0, 2.0)), 0.0, 1.0);

	// animated grain
	float g = hash(floor(SCREEN_UV * grain_scale) + vec2(fract(TIME * grain_speed) * 91.7));
	col += (g - 0.5) * grain_amount;

	// dying-light flicker
	col *= 1.0 - flicker_amount * sin(TIME * 13.0 + hash(vec2(floor(TIME * 3.0), 7.0)) * 6.28);

	COLOR = vec4(col, 1.0);
}

# terrain/map_bootstrap.gd
extends Node

## Ставит нужную карту ДО того, как ZoneController начнёт искать террейн.
## Узел в main.tscn стоит первым среди детей Main - его _ready отрабатывает
## раньше _ready остальных, поэтому подмена проходит без ожидания кадров.

func _ready():
	var params: Dictionary = {}
	if get_tree().root.has_meta("run_params"):
		params = get_tree().root.get_meta("run_params")
	if str(params.get("map", "procedural")) != "pripyat":
		return

	var main := get_parent()
	var old_terrain := main.get_node_or_null("TerrainGenerator")
	if old_terrain:
		main.remove_child(old_terrain)
		old_terrain.queue_free()

	var pripyat: PripyatMap3D = PripyatMap3D.new()
	pripyat.name = "PripyatMap3D"
	main.add_child(pripyat)
	print("MapBootstrap: карта - Припять (процедурная Зона снята)")

# terrain/pripyat_map_3d.gd
extends Node3D
class_name PripyatMap3D

## 3D-карта Припяти/ЧАЭС из OSM-данных (data/pripyat/).
## Заменяет TerrainGenerator в режиме «Припять»: строит рельеф из хайтмапа,
## экструдированные здания с коллизией, основные дороги; отдаёт навмеш
## (bake движком) и совместимый API ("terrain_generator").
## Монолит перемещается по маршруту ярусов кампании: центр Припяти -> Саркофаг.

const DATA_DIR := "res://data/pripyat/"
const GRID_STEP := 12.0            # шаг сетки рельефа (метры, = родное разрешение хайтмапа)
const ROAD_WIDTH_DEFAULT := 6.0
const MAX_ROADS := 120             # дороги в район: ленты на земле
const NAV_BAKE_DELAY := 0.5

# Район игры (bbox): покрывает центр Припяти -> промзону -> Янов -> ЧАЭС
@export var lat_min: float = 51.387
@export var lat_max: float = 51.410
@export var lon_min: float = 30.051
@export var lon_max: float = 30.105

# Маршрут Монолита по ярусам кампании (lat, lon): чем ближе к Саркофагу,
# тем выше ярус и сложнее волны (сложность уже растёт по уровням кампании).
const MONOLITH_ROUTE := [
	[51.4050, 30.0560],  # ярус 1: центр Припяти (площадь у ДК)
	[51.4047, 30.0615],  # ярус 2: стадион
	[51.4025, 30.0530],  # ярус 3: автостанция
	[51.4080, 30.0600],  # ярус 4: северный парк
	[51.4055, 30.0730],  # ярус 5: выезд из города
	[51.3990, 30.0770],  # ярус 6: промзона
	[51.4070, 30.0960],  # ярус 7: станция Янов
	[51.3965, 30.0930],  # ярус 8: подъезд к ЧАЭС
	[51.3905, 30.0985],  # ярус 9: машзал ЧАЭС
	[51.3890, 30.0996],  # ярус 10: Саркофаг
]

# Высоты зданий по типам OSM (метры), остальное - джиттер вокруг дефолта
const KIND_HEIGHTS := {
	"school": 15.0, "hospital": 25.0, "apartments": 18.0, "house": 8.0,
	"industrial": 12.0, "commercial": 12.0, "retail": 10.0, "office": 16.0,
	"church": 20.0, "garage": 4.0, "shed": 4.0, "roof": 6.0
}

var _meta: Dictionary = {}
var _data: Dictionary = {}
var _height_img: Image
var _nav_region: NavigationRegion3D
var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
# Полигоны земли района (вода/лес/промзона) с AABB - для тонировки вершин
var _ground_tints: Array = []
var _decal_textures: Array = []

# Кэш высоты под запросы
var _origin_lat: float = 51.4075
var _origin_lon: float = 30.07
var _hm_lat0: float = 51.435   # северная кромка хайтмапа
var _hm_lon0: float = 30.01    # западная кромка
var _hm_lat_span: float = 0.055
var _hm_lon_span: float = 0.12


func _ready():
	add_to_group("terrain_generator")
	_rng.seed = 20260426
	print("PripyatMap3D: загрузка данных...")
	_load_meta()
	_load_game_json()
	_collect_ground_tints()
	_load_decal_textures()
	_build_terrain()
	_build_buildings()
	_build_roads()
	_build_props()
	_setup_navigation()
	# Небо Припяти: грозовое (polyhaven CC0), чуть глуше обычного
	_apply_sky("res://assets/sky/sky_storm_gloomy_4k.hdr", 0.85)
	print("PripyatMap3D: готов. Зданий в районе: ", _data.get("_buildings_built", 0))


# ==================== ЗАГРУЗКА ДАННЫХ ====================

func _load_meta():
	var f := FileAccess.open(DATA_DIR + "heightmap_meta.json", FileAccess.READ)
	if f == null:
		push_error("PripyatMap3D: нет heightmap_meta.json")
		return
	_meta = JSON.parse_string(f.get_as_text())
	_origin_lat = float(_meta.get("origin_lat", _origin_lat))
	_origin_lon = float(_meta.get("origin_lon", _origin_lon))
	var bbox: Dictionary = _meta.get("bbox", {})
	_hm_lat0 = float(bbox.get("north", _hm_lat0))
	_hm_lon0 = float(bbox.get("west", _hm_lon0))
	_hm_lat_span = float(bbox.get("north", 51.435)) - float(bbox.get("south", 51.38))
	_hm_lon_span = float(bbox.get("east", 30.13)) - float(bbox.get("west", 30.01))
	var tex: Texture2D = load(DATA_DIR + "pripyat_heightmap.png")
	_height_img = tex.get_image()
	if _height_img.is_compressed():
		_height_img.decompress()
	print("PripyatMap3D: хайтмап %dx%d, высоты %.0f..%.0f м" % [
		_height_img.get_width(), _height_img.get_height(),
		float(_meta.get("elev_min_m", 97.0)), float(_meta.get("elev_max_m", 159.0))])


func _load_game_json():
	var f := FileAccess.open(DATA_DIR + "pripyat_zone_game.json", FileAccess.READ)
	if f == null:
		push_error("PripyatMap3D: нет pripyat_zone_game.json")
		return
	_data = JSON.parse_string(f.get_as_text())
	if _data == null or not _data.has("layers"):
		push_error("PripyatMap3D: битый игровой JSON")
		_data = {}


# ==================== КООРДИНАТЫ (как в лоадере 2D) ====================

func latlon_to_world(lat: float, lon: float) -> Vector2:
	var x := (lon - _origin_lon) * 111320.0 * cos(deg_to_rad(_origin_lat))
	var y := (_origin_lat - lat) * 110574.0
	return Vector2(x, y)


func get_terrain_height(wx: float, wz: float) -> float:
	"""Высота рельефа в мировых координатах (билинейно по хайтмапу)."""
	if _height_img == null:
		return 0.0
	var lat := _origin_lat - wz / 110574.0
	var lon := _origin_lon + wx / (111320.0 * cos(deg_to_rad(_origin_lat)))
	var px_f := (lon - _hm_lon0) / _hm_lon_span * float(_height_img.get_width() - 1)
	var py_f := (_hm_lat0 - lat) / _hm_lat_span * float(_height_img.get_height() - 1)
	px_f = clampf(px_f, 0.0, _height_img.get_width() - 1.001)
	py_f = clampf(py_f, 0.0, _height_img.get_height() - 1.001)
	var x0 := int(px_f)
	var y0 := int(py_f)
	var fx := px_f - float(x0)
	var fy := py_f - float(y0)
	var h00 := _height_at(x0, y0)
	var h10 := _height_at(x0 + 1, y0)
	var h01 := _height_at(x0, y0 + 1)
	var h11 := _height_at(x0 + 1, y0 + 1)
	return lerpf(lerpf(h00, h10, fx), lerpf(h01, h11, fx), fy)


func _height_at(px: int, py: int) -> float:
	var elev_min := float(_meta.get("elev_min_m", 97.0))
	var elev_max := float(_meta.get("elev_max_m", 159.0))
	var c := _height_img.get_pixel(clampi(px, 0, _height_img.get_width() - 1),
		clampi(py, 0, _height_img.get_height() - 1))
	return elev_min + float(c.r) * (elev_max - elev_min)


# ==================== ТОНТИРОВКА ЗЕМЛИ И ДЕКАЛИ ====================

## Собирает полигоны земли района (вода/лес/промзона) для тонировки вершин.
## Порядок = приоритет: вода перекрывает всё, потом промзона, болото, лес.
func _collect_ground_tints():
	var layers: Dictionary = _data.get("layers", {})
	var recipes := [
		{"layer": "water", "kinds": {}, "color": Color(0.16, 0.20, 0.22)},
		{"layer": "landuse", "kinds": ["industrial", "quarry"], "color": Color(0.60, 0.58, 0.56)},
		{"layer": "landuse", "kinds": ["wetland"], "color": Color(0.36, 0.42, 0.32)},
		{"layer": "forest", "kinds": {}, "color": Color(0.50, 0.46, 0.28)},
		{"layer": "landuse", "kinds": ["wood", "grass", "meadow"], "color": Color(0.55, 0.52, 0.33)},
	]
	for recipe in recipes:
		var layer: Dictionary = layers.get(str(recipe["layer"]), {})
		for poly in layer.get("polygons", []):
			var outer: Array = poly.get("outer", [])
			if outer.size() < 3:
				continue
			var props: Dictionary = poly.get("props", {})
			var kinds: Array = recipe["kinds"]
			if not kinds.is_empty() and not kinds.has(str(props.get("kind", ""))):
				continue
			var pts := PackedVector2Array()
			var lo := Vector2(INF, INF)
			var hi := Vector2(-INF, -INF)
			for p in outer:
				var v := Vector2(float(p[0]), float(p[1]))
				pts.append(v)
				lo = lo.min(v)
				hi = hi.max(v)
			# Грубое отсечение районом по AABB
			if hi.x < _w_min() or lo.x > _w_max() or hi.y < _d_min() or lo.y > _d_max():
				continue
			_ground_tints.append({
				"pts": pts, "rect": Rect2(lo, hi - lo), "color": recipe["color"]})


func _tint_at(wx: float, wz: float) -> Color:
	"""Цвет земли в точке: первый по приоритету полигон, содержащий точку."""
	for tint in _ground_tints:
		var rect: Rect2 = tint["rect"]
		if not rect.has_point(Vector2(wx, wz)):
			continue
		if Geometry2D.is_point_in_polygon(Vector2(wx, wz), tint["pts"]):
			return tint["color"]
	return Color.WHITE


func _load_decal_textures():
	for layer_name in ["crack_01", "crack_02", "crack_03", "rust_streak_01", "rust_streak_02",
			"stain_dark_01", "stain_dark_02", "stain_oil_01", "moss_patch_01",
			"moss_patch_02", "sign_radiation", "paint_x_white"]:
		var path := "res://assets/decals/%s.png" % name
		if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
			_decal_textures.append(load(path))


## Декаль на случайной стене здания (высота h, контур outer, база base_y)
func _add_wall_decal(outer: Array, base_y: float, h: float, center: Vector2):
	if _decal_textures.is_empty() or outer.size() < 3:
		return
	var i := _rng.randi_range(0, outer.size() - 1)
	var p0: Array = outer[i]
	var p1: Array = outer[(i + 1) % outer.size()]
	var a := Vector2(float(p0[0]), float(p0[1]))
	var b := Vector2(float(p1[0]), float(p1[1]))
	var edge := b - a
	if edge.length() < 2.0:
		return
	var outward := (Vector2(a.x, a.y) + (b - a) * 0.5 - center).normalized()
	var normal := Vector3(-edge.normalized().y * sign(outward.cross(edge.normalized())), 0,
		edge.normalized().x * sign(outward.cross(edge.normalized())))
	# sign может занулиться на вырожденных случаях - фолбэк наружу от центра
	if normal.length_squared() < 0.01:
		normal = Vector3(outward.x, 0, outward.y)
	normal = normal.normalized()

	var wall_y := base_y + _rng.randf_range(1.0, minf(h - 0.5, 5.0))
	var t := _rng.randf_range(0.25, 0.75)
	var pos3 := Vector3(lerpf(a.x, b.x, t), wall_y, lerpf(a.y, b.y, t))

	var decal := Decal.new()
	var w := _rng.randf_range(1.8, 3.2)
	decal.size = Vector3(w, w, 2.0)
	decal.texture_albedo = _decal_textures[_rng.randi_range(0, _decal_textures.size() - 1)]
	decal.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85)
	# Локальная ось Y дефаля = нормаль стены (проекция через стену)
	var y_axis := normal
	var x_axis := Vector3.UP.cross(y_axis)
	if x_axis.length_squared() < 0.01:
		x_axis = Vector3.RIGHT
	x_axis = x_axis.normalized()
	var z_axis := x_axis.cross(y_axis).normalized()
	decal.basis = Basis(x_axis, y_axis, z_axis)
	decal.position = pos3 + normal * 1.0
	add_child(decal)


# ==================== РЕЛЬЕФ ====================

func _build_terrain():
	var w_min := (lon_min - _origin_lon) * 111320.0 * cos(deg_to_rad(_origin_lat))
	var w_max := (lon_max - _origin_lon) * 111320.0 * cos(deg_to_rad(_origin_lat))
	var d_min := (_origin_lat - lat_max) * 110574.0
	var d_max := (_origin_lat - lat_min) * 110574.0

	var cols := int(ceil((w_max - w_min) / GRID_STEP))
	var rows := int(ceil((d_max - d_min) / GRID_STEP))
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)

	for iz in range(rows):
		for ix in range(cols):
			var x0 := w_min + ix * GRID_STEP
			var z0 := d_min + iz * GRID_STEP
			var x1 := x0 + GRID_STEP
			var z1 := z0 + GRID_STEP
			var h00 := get_terrain_height(x0, z0)
			var h10 := get_terrain_height(x1, z0)
			var h01 := get_terrain_height(x0, z1)
			var h11 := get_terrain_height(x1, z1)
			# Тонировка: вода/лес/промзона красят вершины (умножаются на текстуру)
			var tint := _tint_at(x0 + GRID_STEP * 0.5, z0 + GRID_STEP * 0.5)
			# Два треугольника, нормали вверх (порядок против часовой сверху)
			_tri(st, tint,
				Vector3(x0, h00, z0), Vector3(x0, h01, z1), Vector3(x1, h11, z1))
			_tri(st, tint,
				Vector3(x0, h00, z0), Vector3(x1, h11, z1), Vector3(x1, h10, z0))

	var mesh := st.commit()
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = "TerrainMesh"
	mi.mesh = mesh
	# Тот же материал, что в процедурной Зоне: грязь + vertex colors не нужны
	mi.material_override = _ground_material()
	add_child(mi)

	# Коллизия рельефа одним тримешем
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "TerrainBody"
	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var concave := ConcavePolygonShape3D.new()
	concave.set_faces(mesh.get_faces())
	shape.shape = concave
	body.add_child(shape)
	add_child(body)
	print("PripyatMap3D: рельеф %dx%d ячеек" % [cols, rows])


func _tri(st: SurfaceTool, color: Color, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3):
	var n := (b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()
	st.set_color(color)
	st.set_normal(n)
	st.add_vertex(a)
	st.set_color(color)
	st.set_normal(n)
	st.add_vertex(b)
	st.set_color(color)
	st.set_normal(n)
	st.add_vertex(c)


func _ground_material() -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.52, 0.50, 0.42)
	m.roughness = 1.0
	# Vertex colors (вода/лес/промзона) умножаются на текстуру земли
	m.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/textures/pbr/dirt_dry/albedo.jpg"):
		m.albedo_texture = load("res://assets/textures/pbr/dirt_dry/albedo.jpg")
		m.uv1_triplanar = true
		m.uv1_scale = Vector3(0.08, 0.08, 0.08)
		if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/textures/pbr/dirt_dry/normal.png"):
			m.normal_enabled = true
			m.normal_texture = load("res://assets/textures/pbr/dirt_dry/normal.png")
			m.normal_scale = 0.6
	return m


# ==================== ЗДАНИЯ ====================

func _build_buildings():
	var layers: Dictionary = _data.get("layers", {})
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var collision_faces := PackedVector3Array()
	var built := 0

	for layer_name in ["buildings", "building_parts"]:
		var layer: Dictionary = layers.get(layer_name, {})
		for poly in layer.get("polygons", []):
			var outer: Array = poly.get("outer", [])
			if outer.size() < 3:
				continue
			# Фильтр района: центр контура в bbox
			var c := _ring_center(outer)
			if c.x < _w_min() or c.x > _w_max() or c.y < _d_min() or c.y > _d_max():
				continue

			var props: Dictionary = poly.get("props", {})
			var height := _building_height(props)
			var base_y := get_terrain_height(c.x, c.y) - 0.5
			var top_y := base_y + height

			# Декали грязи на крупных зданиях
			if height >= 6.0 and _rng.randf() < 0.5:
				_add_wall_decal(outer, base_y, height, c)

			# Стены по контуру
			var n := outer.size()
			for i in range(n):
				var p0: Array = outer[i]
				var p1: Array = outer[(i + 1) % n]
				var a := Vector3(float(p0[0]), base_y, float(p0[1]))
				var b := Vector3(float(p1[0]), base_y, float(p1[1]))
				_quad(st,
					Vector3(a.x, base_y, a.z), Vector3(b.x, base_y, b.z),
					Vector3(b.x, top_y, b.z), Vector3(a.x, top_y, a.z))
				# Коллизия: те же грани
				collision_faces.append_array(PackedVector3Array([
					Vector3(a.x, base_y, a.z), Vector3(b.x, base_y, b.z), Vector3(b.x, top_y, b.z),
					Vector3(a.x, base_y, a.z), Vector3(b.x, top_y, b.z), Vector3(a.x, top_y, a.z)]))

			# Крыша: триангуляция контура
			var poly2d := PackedVector2Array()
			for p in outer:
				poly2d.append(Vector2(float(p[0]), float(p[1])))
			var tris := Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon(poly2d)
			if tris.size() >= 3:
				for i in range(0, tris.size(), 3):
					var a2 := poly2d[tris[i]]
					var b2 := poly2d[tris[i + 1]]
					var c2 := poly2d[tris[i + 2]]
					_quad(st,
						Vector3(a2.x, top_y, a2.y), Vector3(b2.x, top_y, b2.y),
						Vector3(c2.x, top_y, c2.y), Vector3(c2.x, top_y, c2.y))
			built += 1

	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = "BuildingsMesh"
	mi.mesh = st.commit()
	mi.material_override = _building_material()
	add_child(mi)

	# Одна коллизия на все здания (тримеш)
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "BuildingsBody"
	var shape := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var concave := ConcavePolygonShape3D.new()
	concave.set_faces(collision_faces)
	shape.shape = concave
	body.add_child(shape)
	add_child(body)

	_data["_buildings_built"] = built


func _ring_center(ring: Array) -> Vector2:
	var cx := 0.0
	var cy := 0.0
	for p in ring:
		cx += float(p[0])
		cy += float(p[1])
	return Vector2(cx / float(ring.size()), cy / float(ring.size()))


func _building_height(props: Dictionary) -> float:
	var kind := str(props.get("kind", ""))
	var base: float = float(KIND_HEIGHTS.get(kind, 12.0))
	return base * _rng.randf_range(0.85, 1.15)


func _w_min() -> float:
	return (lon_min - _origin_lon) * 111320.0 * cos(deg_to_rad(_origin_lat))


func _w_max() -> float:
	return (lon_max - _origin_lon) * 111320.0 * cos(deg_to_rad(_origin_lat))


func _d_min() -> float:
	return (_origin_lat - lat_max) * 110574.0


func _d_max() -> float:
	return (_origin_lat - lat_min) * 110574.0


func _quad(st: SurfaceTool, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, d: Vector3):
	# Два треугольника a-b-c и a-c-d с общей плоской нормалью
	var n := (b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()
	st.set_normal(n)
	st.add_vertex(a)
	st.add_vertex(b)
	st.add_vertex(c)
	st.set_normal(n)
	st.add_vertex(a)
	st.add_vertex(c)
	st.add_vertex(d)


func _building_material() -> StandardMaterial3D:
	# Единый бетон панелек - как в процедурной Зоне
	var m := _ground_material()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.50, 0.50, 0.47)
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/textures/pbr/concrete_wall_dirty/albedo.jpg"):
		m.albedo_texture = load("res://assets/textures/pbr/concrete_wall_dirty/albedo.jpg")
		m.uv1_scale = Vector3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
		if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/textures/pbr/concrete_wall_dirty/normal.png"):
			m.normal_texture = load("res://assets/textures/pbr/concrete_wall_dirty/normal.png")
			m.normal_enabled = true
			m.normal_scale = 0.8
	return m


# ==================== ДОРОГИ ====================

func _build_roads():
	var layers: Dictionary = _data.get("layers", {})
	var roads: Dictionary = layers.get("roads", {})
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var road_count := 0

	for line in roads.get("lines", []):
		if road_count >= MAX_ROADS:
			break
		var points: Array = line.get("points", [])
		if points.size() < 2:
			continue
		var props: Dictionary = line.get("props", {})
		var width: float = float(props.get("width", ROAD_WIDTH_DEFAULT))
		width = clampf(width, 3.0, 14.0)
		road_count += 1

	# Лента по полилинии с выборкой каждой второй точки (экономия)
		var prev_left: Vector3
		var prev_right: Vector3
		var started := false
		for i in range(0, points.size(), 2):
			var p: Array = points[i]
			var wx := float(p[0])
			var wz := float(p[1])
			if wx < _w_min() or wx > _w_max() or wz < _d_min() or wz > _d_max():
				started = false
				continue
			# Направление - к следующей выбранной точке (или от предыдущей)
			var dir := Vector3.ZERO
			if i + 1 < points.size():
				var q: Array = points[i + 1]
				dir = Vector3(float(q[0]) - wx, 0, float(q[1]) - wz)
			elif started:
				dir = Vector3(wx - (prev_left.x + prev_right.x) * 0.5, 0,
					wz - (prev_left.z + prev_right.z) * 0.5)
			if dir.length() < 0.01:
				continue
			dir = dir.normalized()
			var perp := Vector3(-dir.z, 0, dir.x) * width * 0.5
			var y := get_terrain_height(wx, wz) + 0.15
			var left := Vector3(wx, y, wz) - perp
			var right := Vector3(wx, y, wz) + perp
			if started:
				_quad(st, prev_left, prev_right, right, left)
			prev_left = left
			prev_right = right
			started = true

	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = "RoadsMesh"
	mi.mesh = st.commit()
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = Color(0.18, 0.18, 0.19)
	m.roughness = 0.95
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/textures/pbr/asphalt_old/albedo.jpg"):
		m.albedo_texture = load("res://assets/textures/pbr/asphalt_old/albedo.jpg")
		m.uv1_triplanar = true
		m.uv1_scale = Vector3(0.25, 0.25, 0.25)
	mi.material_override = m
	add_child(mi)


# ==================== ПРОПСЫ УЛИЦ ====================

## Рассыпает машины/фонари/деревья/бочки/лавки «по смыслу местности»
## (terrain/pripyat_props.gd, плотности - PripyatPropsData). Вызов до
## _setup_navigation: коллизии пропсов вырезаются из навмеша.
func _build_props():
	var layers: Dictionary = _data.get("layers", {})
	var bounds := Rect2(_w_min(), _d_min(), _w_max() - _w_min(), _d_max() - _d_min())
	var props_root := PripyatProps.build(self, layers, bounds, get_terrain_height)
	add_child(props_root)


# ==================== НАВМЕШ И СОВМЕСТИМОСТЬ ====================

func _setup_navigation():
	_nav_region = NavigationRegion3D.new()
	var nm := NavigationMesh.new()
	nm.agent_radius = 0.7
	nm.agent_height = 2.0
	nm.agent_max_climb = 0.6
	nm.cell_size = 0.5
	_nav_region.navigation_mesh = nm
	add_child(_nav_region)
	# Печатаём геометрию района (рельеф+здания уже дети) и печём в потоке
	_nav_region.bake_navigation_mesh(true)
	_nav_region.bake_finished.connect(func():
		print("PripyatMap3D: навмеш испечён"))
	# Совместимость: пока печётся, движок использует пустой навмеш;
	# сталкеры начнут ходить после NAV_BAKE_DELAY - см. force_rebuild_navigation


func _update_chunks():
	pass  # совместимость с ZoneController._force_initial_chunk_load


func force_rebuild_navigation():
	# Печь один раз; повторные вызовы игнорируем
	if _nav_region and not _nav_region.navigation_mesh.has_polygon(0):
		_nav_region.bake_navigation_mesh(true)


func get_loaded_chunks_count() -> int:
	return 1


# ==================== МАРШРУТ МОНОЛИТА ====================

## Позиция Монолита для яруса кампании (1-10): центр Припяти -> Саркофаг
func monolith_position_for_level(level: int) -> Vector3:
	var tier: int = clampi((level - 1) / 10 + 1, 1, MONOLITH_ROUTE.size())
	var wp: Array = MONOLITH_ROUTE[tier - 1]
	var w := latlon_to_world(float(wp[0]), float(wp[1]))
	var y := get_terrain_height(w.x, w.y)
	print("PripyatMap3D: Монолит яруса %d -> %.0f, %.0f (h=%.1f)" % [tier, w.x, w.y, y])
	return Vector3(w.x, y, w.y)


func get_footstep_surface() -> String:
	return "stone"


func _apply_sky(hdr_path: String, energy: float):
	"""Панорамное небо в WorldEnvironment главной сцены; Припять глушит энергию"""
	var we := get_parent().get_node_or_null("WorldEnvironment") as WorldEnvironment
	if we == null or not ResourceLoader.exists(hdr_path):
		return
	var mat := PanoramaSkyMaterial.new()
	mat.panorama = load(hdr_path)
	mat.energy_multiplier = energy
	var sky := Sky.new()
	sky.sky_material = mat
	we.environment.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	we.environment.sky = sky
	we.environment.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
